terms.comment: At first of pine or other resinous wood (Lewis & Short).

terms.gloss: a torch of pinewood; resinous pine
evidence: Cic. Pis. 46: taedae ārdentēs Furiārum (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: First the pitch-pine itself, then its wood, then a torch of it; also the wedding torch.
